Congratulations all on the new medal we won yesterday. As our kingdom opens, we are going to find that many of the new kingdoms who have access to 277 are able to have 100 members. Having 25% more members (Admiral, Del, do the math) is a crucial advantage that we need to get as soon as possible. We need 600 Million of each resource so….

Here is a game that we are going to play within the clan. We are dividing the clan into two teams, Red and Blue. Teams will be selected by alternating team members sorted by power (as of 10AM EST on 2/5). The game will be played in 3 rounds, the first ending when we have 1/3 of each resource (at least 200MM of each of steel, concrete, planks and religious tractates) we need to upgrade our buildings enough for 100 members, the second ending when we have 2/3 of each resource and the third when we are at 100%. Best 2/3 rounds wins the game.

How do you win a round? Each round consists of 3 mini-games. Best 2 of 3 mini-games wins the round. You win a mini-game by collecting more steel, concrete or planks than the other team in that round. Religious tractates are a wild card and the team can use them on a 1:1 basis to other resources (strategically, they are harder to get, but since you can deploy them into each of the other resources, they have added value).
